title: Docusaurus pages front matter v3.10
description: Front matter accepted by @docusaurus/plugin-content-pages as of Docusaurus 3.10. Docusaurus marks no field as required, so this is a format check, not a presence check. Unknown keys are tolerated, matching Docusaurus. The field set is the smallest of the three: standalone pages carry no sidebar, pagination, or tag metadata. See https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/plugins/@docusaurus/plugin-content-pages#markdown-front-matter

title.description: Page title. Defaults to the Markdown title. May be empty.

description.description: Meta description for search engines. Defaults to the first line of Markdown content. May be empty.

keywords.description: Keywords meta tag for search engines.

image.description: Cover image used in social link previews. A site-root path such as `/img/card.png` is legal.

slug.description: Custom URL for this page. Defaults to the file path; `/` makes it the site root.

wrapperClassName.description: Class name added to the page wrapper, for targeting this page in CSS.

hide_table_of_contents.description: Hide the right-hand table of contents.

draft.description: A draft page is available in development only. Cannot be combined with `unlisted`.

unlisted.description: An unlisted page is published but hidden from search and sitemaps. Cannot be combined with `draft`.
